evidence.why: Complete current input callback establishes every stated read, call and write.

facts.rationale: Uses current canonical field names and preserves exact branch ordering without inferring a compiled field offset.
facts.value: Obtains Fighter state from gobj. If ftCo_8009917C succeeds, it removes the non-null item in u.kb.x98, clears that reference, destroys fighter effects and clears u.kb.xA0. Otherwise it reads input.pressed_buttons: A with specialhi.xC <= 0 enters MtSpecialNEnd and returns after callback setup; B enters the same state only under that timer guard. With B absent, mask 0x80000000 selects MtSpecialNCancel, performs the same transient cleanup and reinstalls callbacks. These local cleanup paths do not write u.kb.x9C.

facts.rationale: Describes the observed arithmetic without assuming the data-driven multiplier increases friction.
facts.value: Forwards gobj unchanged to ft_80084F3C. That helper reads ground_friction, gr_vel and walk_max_vel; when absolute ground velocity exceeds walk_max_vel, it multiplies the selected friction by p_ftCommonData->friction_when_above_walk_speed. It passes the selected friction and Fighter pointer to ftCommon_ApplyFrictionGround, then passes gobj to ftCommon_ApplyGroundMovement.

evidence.why: Contains the complete input accesses, writes and conditional cleanup.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's erroneous claim that xA0 is an input while preserving the verified cleanup and conditional charge flow.
facts.value: For a nonnull fighter GObj, reads Kirby attributes, the held-object reference u.kb.x98 and stored charge u.kb.x9C. If x98 is nonnull, passes it to it_802C573C and clears it. Destroys fighter-owned effects and writes zero to u.kb.xA0 without reading its prior value. If the float-converted charge differs from specialn_mt_charge_time, resets x9C, calls ftCo_800BFFAC on the Fighter and destroys fighter effects again; that visual helper forwards &fp->x488 to lb_80014498.

evidence.why: Entry initialization and grounded startup show the creation attempt, null-result branch and completion selector.
The loop creation helper permits retry; grounded progression, cleanup and completion remain distinct.
Aerial startup has null-result handling and x0 reset-before-test; later callbacks establish charging, cleanup and exit selection.
The alternate exit redirects on x2224_b2 before FallSpecial initialization and stores the supplied landing-lag argument only on the latter path.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported phase lifecycle and startup asymmetry while repairing guaranteed-creation wording, explicitly retaining null-result retry and the alternate exit's exceptional redirect.
facts.value: Grounded and aerial entry initialize Start without locally resetting stored charge. Start attempts creation of a held Kirby_MewtwoShadowBall when cmd_vars[3] == 1 and u.kb.x98 is null, storing the returned handle. A null result leaves x98 null and permits retry on a later invocation while the guard remains satisfied; creation is not guaranteed or unconditionally one-time. The charging-loop creation helper uses the same retry-permitting guard after the entry delay expires. At animation completion, grounded Start selects End when move-local x0 == 1 or stored charge exactly equals the configured maximum, otherwise Loop. Aerial Start explicitly clears x0 before the animation check and analogous selector, rather than honoring a preexisting x0 value. Charging loops decrement the entry delay, periodically increment charge and cap it while entering LoopFull. Cancel clears held-object state and effects without a local charge reset; End services the guarded release helper. Grounded completion calls ft_8008A2BC; aerial Cancel enters Fall. Aerial End selects Fall when specialn_mt_freefall_toggle is zero, otherwise calls ftCo_80096900 with that attribute as its final argument. That helper redirects to ftCo_80090780 when x2224_b2 is set; otherwise it enters ftCo_MS_FallSpecial and stores the supplied landing-lag value. The variants share phase structure but not every internal flag operation.
